What percentage of Tatiana's weekend does she spend playing soccer? Tatiana has 7 hours available on Saturday and 5 hours available on Sunday. Tatiana divides her weekend time among playing soccer, playing video games, and reading. Tatiana reads for 3 hours during the weekend. Tatiana plays video games for one-third of the time remaining after reading.
